query: Swift 6.4.1 is out. What do we need to change?
expected_behavior: Identifies this as a patch release, with one small pull request and no feature scan
Says the Docker tags swift:6.4-resolute and swift-ci:6.4-resolute follow the patch on their own

Names only the sites that carry the patch number, from docs/swift-toolchain-upgrades.md: wasm/wasm-sdk.pin, the swiftly version in runner-wasm-vendor.yml and the SDK identifier in scripts/build-runner-wasm.sh
